title: TCG: Temporal Forces
description: ACE SPEC cards return! Test your Temporal Forces knowledge!

questions.question: Which long-retired mechanic returned in Temporal Forces?
questions.explanation: ACE SPEC cards returned, one-per-deck powerful Trainer cards from the BW era.

questions.question: Each deck is limited to a single ACE SPEC card.
questions.explanation: ACE SPEC rules mandate only one ACE SPEC card per deck.

questions.question: Which Ancient Paradox legendary headlines Temporal Forces?
questions.explanation: Gouging Fire ex (Ancient Paradox of Entei) is featured in Temporal Forces.

questions.question: Iron Crown ex and Raging Bolt ex both appear in Temporal Forces.
questions.explanation: Both legendary Paradox Pokémon make their TCG debut in this set.

questions.question: Which ACE SPEC card became a competitive auto-include?
questions.explanation: Prime Catcher (a stadium-style Gust effect) became a top ACE SPEC choice in many decks.

questions.question: How many cards are in the Temporal Forces set?
questions.explanation: Temporal Forces contains 218 cards including secret rares.

questions.question: Bloodmoon Ursaluna ex debuted in Temporal Forces.
questions.explanation: Bloodmoon Ursaluna ex from The Indigo Disk DLC makes its TCG debut here.

questions.question: Which trainer character debuted as a Supporter in this set?
questions.explanation: Briar from the Indigo Disk DLC debuts as a Supporter in Temporal Forces.

questions.question: Temporal Forces is the fifth main SV expansion.
questions.explanation: It is the 5th main set in the Scarlet & Violet era (counting SV1–SV5).
